1.explanation: This snippet renders two groups of Tabs side by side: the first uses the default style, the second uses container tabs (type="container"). In the default tabs you will see long labels correctly truncated with an ellipsis and 16px padding from each edge. In the container tabs you will see the same long label cut off without that extra horizontal padding or polished ellipsis behavior. This reproduces the bug so you can inspect the CSS rules and adjust the container tabs’ .carbon\--tabs__nav-item or .carbon\--tabs__nav-link styles to apply text-overflow: ellipsis with the same left/right padding (16px) as the default type.
1.bug_scenario: When rendering a Tabs component with type="container", any tab labels that exceed the available width are getting cut off abruptly at the edges, without the 16px padding and smooth ellipsis behavior that the default (non-container) tabs apply. In the screenshots you can see the container-style tabs on top truncating text right at the edge, whereas the default tabs on the bottom apply 16px of left/right padding and an ellipsis so the cut-off looks consistent.
